title: Mechanisms involved in the regulation of carbohydrate and lipid metabolism by oleanane-type pentacyclic triterpenes.
authors: Li, Jiaxuan; Zhao, Chong; Yin, Shutao; Hu, Hongbo
one_liner_zh: 综述齐墩果烷型五环三萜类化合物调节糖脂代谢的机制，虽提及抑制转录因子并辅以分子对接预测化合物与代谢蛋白的相互作用，但核心是代谢调控而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法仅作补充，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Oleanane-type pentacyclic triterpene is a major class of naturally occurring pentacyclic triterpenes with various bioactivities. A growing body of evidence suggests that glycyrrhetinic acid (GA), oleanolic acid (OA), and maslinic acid (MA), three representatives of oleanane-type pentacyclic triterpenes, are capable of regulating metabolism of carbohydrate and lipid, accordingly improving energy metabolism and alleviating metabolic disorders. A number of mechanisms have been found to contribute to the regulatory effects of GA, OA and MA on carbohydrate and lipid metabolism. These mainly include targeting transporters of glucose or fatty acids, reshaping gut microbiota, activating autophagy, inhibiting transcription factors (hepatic nuclear factor 4alpha, HNF4alpha; peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor, PPARgamma; sterol regulatory element binding protein 1, SREBP-1), inactivating metabolic enzymes (alpha-glucosidase; 11beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1, 11beta-HSD1), and suppressing oxidative stress. Understanding of the mechanisms involved in the regulatory effect of GA, OA and MA on carbohydrate and lipid metabolism will promote their application in improving metabolism and fighting against the dysregulated energy metabolism-related diseases. In this review, we present an overview of the current understanding of the mechanisms underlying these representative pentacyclic triterpenes-mediated metabolic regulation in both physiological and pathological conditions. We also incorporate molecular docking analyses to complement the mechanistic discussion by predicting direct interactions between GA/OA/MA and key proteins involved in glucose and lipid metabolism. Furthermore, we propose the issues that need to be further investigated for promoting clinical utilization of these compounds in the future studies.
abstract_zh: 齐墩果烷型五环三萜（oleanane-type pentacyclic triterpene）是天然存在的五环三萜类化合物中的主要类别，具有多种生物活性。越来越多的证据表明，甘草次酸（glycyrrhetinic acid, GA）、齐墩果酸（oleanolic acid, OA）和山楂酸（maslinic acid, MA）作为齐墩果烷型五环三萜的三个代表，能够调节碳水化合物和脂质代谢，从而改善能量代谢并缓解代谢紊乱。已发现多种机制参与GA、OA和MA对碳水化合物及脂质代谢的调节作用，主要包括靶向葡萄糖或脂肪酸转运体、重塑肠道菌群、激活自噬、抑制转录因子（肝细胞核因子4α，HNF4α；过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ，PPARγ；固醇调节元件结合蛋白1，SREBP-1）、失活代谢酶（α-葡萄糖苷酶；11β-羟基类固醇脱氢酶1型，11β-HSD1）以及抑制氧化应激。理解GA、OA和MA对碳水化合物和脂质代谢调节作用的机制，将促进其在改善代谢和对抗能量代谢失调相关疾病中的应用。在本综述中，我们概述了目前对这些代表性五环三萜介导的代谢调节在生理和病理条件下的机制理解。我们还结合分子对接分析，通过预测GA/OA/MA与参与葡萄糖和脂质代谢的关键蛋白之间的直接相互作用，补充机制讨论。此外，我们提出了未来研究中需进一步探讨的问题，以促进这些化合物的临床利用。
